toast.generated: New templates are ready for review.
toast.approved: Template approved. The engine can use it now.

generate.intro: The AI writes from this engine's brief. It only uses facts and links that are in the brief; you review every template before the engine can use it.
generate.customPlaceholder: e.g. invite to the Sunday demo class
generate.feedbackPlaceholder: e.g. shorter, warmer, mention the weekend batch

email.heading: Email templates
email.subheading: Emails the engine can send, written by AI from the brief. Approve a template before the engine can use it; editing an approved one makes a new version.

modes.FREE_WRITE: Email mode: the engine writes each email itself. Approved templates are kept for when you switch modes.
modes.TEMPLATE_ONLY: Email mode: the engine only sends approved templates, filling in each person's details.
modes.TEMPLATE_PLUS_AI_LINE: Email mode: approved templates, plus one short personal line the AI writes for each person.

email.emptyState: No email templates yet. Generate a few from this engine's brief.

preview.heading: Email preview
preview.sampleNote: Filled with the sample values. This is exactly what a send renders.
preview.missing: Still empty: {{list}}. A real send waits until every variable has a value.

edit.heading: Edit email template
edit.newVersionNote: Your changes become a new version for review. The approved version keeps sending until you approve this one.
edit.title: Title (for you)
edit.subject: Subject
edit.preheader: Preview line (shown after the subject in the inbox)
edit.variables: Variables, a sample value, and where each value comes from

errors.badName: Variable names use lowercase letters, digits and _ only.
errors.duplicateName: A variable name is used twice.
errors.unknownPlaceholder: {{name}} is used but not listed as a variable.

whatsapp.disabledByMeta: Meta disabled or paused this template, so the engine no longer sends it. Generate an alternative.

wizard.coldHint: Turn on if these people never contacted you (for example leads found by the Lead Agent). Every email must then tell people how to stop.
